# Cascades Human Capital Management

> Cascades Human Capital Management (Cascades HCM) is an HR advisory and business transformation firm. It provides fractional HR leadership (including fractional CHRO and interim HR leadership), workforce strategy, AI readiness consulting, operating model and HR technology advisory, executive search, and brand strategy to founders, CEOs, and growing organizations in the United States and internationally.

Cascades works upstream of HR symptoms, on structure, decision rights, evidence, and capability, using a four-stage method called the Ascend Framework (Assess, Build, Validate, Sustain) and a six-step delivery lifecycle (Discovery, Assessment, Recommendation, Implementation, Validation, Knowledge Transfer).

Who it is for: founders and CEOs who need senior HR leadership without a full-time hire; COOs and CHROs leading restructures, HR technology rollouts, or AI adoption; boards appointing senior leaders.

Contact: admin@cascadeshcm.com. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/cascades-human-capital-management/. Book a free 60-minute consult: https://cascadeshcm.com/connect.html

## Capabilities
- [People: fractional HR leadership and workforce strategy](https://cascadeshcm.com/people.html): fractional CHRO, interim HR, HR operations, compliance, employee relations, workforce planning, organizational design.
- [Intelligence: AI readiness and workforce transformation](https://cascadeshcm.com/intelligence.html): AI readiness, organizational diagnostics, change enablement.
- [Infrastructure: operating model and HR technology](https://cascadeshcm.com/infrastructure.html): operating models, process and workflow design, HR technology implementation, project management.
- [Experience: brand and employer brand strategy](https://cascadeshcm.com/experience.html): brand strategy, positioning, employer value proposition, digital experience.
- [Executive search](https://cascadeshcm.com/executive-search.html): retained search for CHRO, senior HR, and leadership roles.
